UPSTREAM: mb/google/*: Remove selection of DRIVERS_PS2_KEYBOARD Until now, chromeec was doing keyboard initialization for the boards that have DRIVERS_PS2_KEYBOARD selected. However, coreboot does not leave the keyboard controller in a default reset state. This could result in payloads or OS failing to probe the controller as there could be stale data buffered in the controller during the handoff. Since the boards using chromeec already perform keyboard initialization in payload, there is no need to initialize the keyboard in coreboot too. This change gets rid of DRIVERS_PS2_KEYBOARD selection from all google mainboards using chromeec. BUG=b:110024487 TEST=Keyboard works fine after booting to OS even if user hits keys during BIOS to OS handoff.
